user_query: I want to improve the SEO of my website and need to analyze its backlinks. Can you provide me with the top backlinks, poor backlinks, and new backlinks? For each backlink, I would like to know the URLs of the referring pages, the anchor texts, and whether the links are image links or nofollow links. It would be helpful if you could also provide the inlink ranks and first seen dates for these backlinks.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of top backlinks for the website.
Fetch the list of poor backlinks for the website.
Fetch the list of new backlinks for the website.
Collect detailed information for each backlink including referring page URLs, anchor texts, link type (image or nofollow), inlink ranks, and first seen dates.
